description: Header file defining the FileEnumerator class for enumerating files in a directory, including nested classes, enums, and method declarations.

classes.name: FileEnumerator
classes.description: Class for enumerating files and directories within a specified path, supporting recursive search and pattern matching.

classes.name: FileEnumerator::FileInfo
classes.description: Nested class providing information about individual files, such as name, size, modification time, and type.

methods.name: FileEnumerator
methods.description: Constructs a FileEnumerator with specified root path, recursion, file type, pattern, and search policy.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Returns the next file path in the enumeration, or an empty path if no more files.

methods.name: GetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the current file in the enumeration.

methods.name: ShouldSkip
methods.description: Determines if a given path should be skipped during enumeration.

methods.name: IsTypeMatched
methods.description: Checks if a file or directory matches the specified type filter.

methods.name: IsPatternMatched
methods.description: Checks if a file path matches the specified pattern.
